slices.focus: Caleb develops a low-cost hobby of photographing native drainage-friendly plants with his phone as a stress-relief practice during the rough stretch
slices.summary: During a period of feeling battered and defensive, Caleb stumbles into a small hobby of taking phone photos of bioswale plantings and roadside grasses. The habit costs nothing, fits into his existing day, and gives him a private reset button that doesn't require an audience or performance.
